scope: Typed persistence proposal at commit 81d78af2 plus sibling Truss, Ashlar and Weft documentation
independence: Findings were formed before reading astra-review.json.

verdict.draftDesign: Sound with specified changes for model generation; reject engine substrate adoption as framed.
verdict.implementation: Not ready: blocking gaps in value-binding authority, core 0.8 type mapping, temporal basis and engine storage model.

findings.issue: Adoption contract assumed per-entity tables; Truss and Ashlar store domain values in generic JSON carriers keyed by catalog property IDs and already generate their DDL from UMF.
findings.resolution: CONTRACT-069 rewritten: engines implement CONTRACT-072 protocols over their protected paths; engine storage is never a binding target.

findings.issue: Bypass guard for Truss protected paths was prose only; generated Core tables, ORM entities and create/patch encoders exposed write paths; SQLAlchemy relationship cascade defaults to save-update, merge.
findings.resolution: Generated code holds no table handles or SQLAlchemy/PySpark mappings (CONTRACT-068); writes only through actions or catalog commands (ADR-004).

findings.issue: valueBindings were new semantics carried only in the compile request; no conflict rules with core meaning.
findings.resolution: Owner decision: extension. CONTRACT-070 umf.access with a normative conflict table.

findings.issue: Existing PostgreSQL projections accept only core 0.7; no native type input for core 0.8.
findings.resolution: Owner decision: core 0.8. Native column types are authored in umf.access ColumnSets; SQL lowering belongs to Weft backends.

findings.issue: Nothing selected instant versus local timestamp.
findings.resolution: CONTRACT-070 FieldView.temporal is required for timestamp Fields.

findings.issue: Pydantic aliases break typed constructors for non-identifier IDs.
findings.resolution: No aliases; codecs own name mapping (CONTRACT-067/068).

findings.issue: Decimal rule contradicted CONTRACT-040 scale equality; Pydantic decimal_places is an upper bound.
KEY_IDENTITY included the bundle input digest.
findings.resolution: KEY_IDENTITY matches CoreKeyIdentity plus document/core identity; BUNDLE_INPUT_DIGEST separate.

findings.issue: SchemaMatch lacked table identity and version; PostgreSQL observation missed identity/generated columns.
findings.resolution: CONTRACT-072 verify() observes relation OID or table UUID, attidentity and attgenerated; Ashlar reads pinned through its resolver (CONTRACT-069).

findings.issue: Bundle writer machinery: changing import paths, no garbage collection, no abandoned-lock recovery.
findings.resolution: Fixed checked-in directory with manifest, hand-edit refusal and CI drift check (CONTRACT-067).

findings.issue: Profile code not in input digest; no float carrier stated; revalidation mechanism unnamed; MISSING sentinel and toArrow transport not considered; stale PostgreSQL and Spark pins; unachievable US-084/085 criteria; machine-specific prompt paths.
findings.resolution: codeSha256 in profile; floats refuse except Vector; revalidate_instances=always; Pydantic MISSING adopted (owner decision); pins deferred to B-TP-001; stories rewritten as US-080 to US-088.

astraAssessment: Astra's internal-consistency fixes mostly held (A2, A5, A8). It did not read sibling repositories and missed C1, C2 and C9. Its A1 fix produced C3 and its A9 fix produced C8.
ownerDecisions: Value bindings become an authored extension (umf.access).
Keep the Truss and Ashlar adoption goal.
Build an ORM-like typed SDK with action support, over Weft, for raw tables and Truss ontologies.
Raw-table execution uses the host platform's native SQL interface (Postgres, Lakebase, Unity Catalog/Spark SQL).
Follow common Python query DSL conventions (SQLAlchemy, Django, PySpark, Polars); no string column references; use type checking to catch errors early and support refactoring.
Include semantic and keyword search in the same interface, with implementations selecting mechanisms; consider SOQL/SOSL prior art.
limitations: Review and revision are design evidence only; no implementation, native qualification or consumer adoption.
Sibling repositories were read from docs-only clones at their default-branch heads on 2026-10-15.
